commit.message:
T-2388: integrate current dev (492f285c), append-only docs only

`dev` landed T-3041's parade slabs and two changelog folds while this head's
gate and smoke were running. This integration is bookkeeping, not content: the
ONLY two conflicts are `docs/ROADMAP.md` and `docs/STATUS.md`, both append-only,
both resolved by keeping dev's new block WHOLE and re-applying this branch's
block AFTER it. Everything else auto-merged — no registry row, no record and no
mesh conflicted.

`compile_liberties.py` (996 liberties, the exact union of dev's 995 and this
branch's 996), `compile_source_use.py` (SOURCE USE PASS — 559 sources) and
`compile_scene.py --all` were re-run on the merged tree and changed nothing that
was not already consistent. `assets/manifest.json` and `assets/manifest.web.json`
were audited row by row again: dev changed no row this lap, this branch's 26 and
1 rows stand, nothing lost or invented. dev's folded `changelog.d/T-2374.json`
is correctly gone and this PR's `changelog.d/T-2388.json` is untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+### First Fort parade presence — T-3041, 2026-11-04
+The first fort's loaded earth-only parade asset is supplied by its named trodden-ground owner, so it is now listed separately from direct building batches. No bounding box or standing building is invented. Failed, empty or malformed assets remain missing, and the second fort's sundial still has to draw. The ground layer already drew independently; this corrects the false missing-host report, not an absent ground surface. Actual createBuildings regression checks pass; the earlier 1812 desktop runtime failed its zero-console-error check and remains preserved as a failure.
